description: Multi-tool infrastructure specialist handling VM provisioning (Proxmox), IaC deployment (OpenTofu), and configuration management (Ansible)

use_cases: Provisioning new virtual machines in Proxmox cluster
Creating VM templates for rapid deployment
best_practices: Always specify adequate resources (CPU, memory, storage)
Use templates when possible for consistency
Tag VMs with environment and purpose metadata
Start VMs in stopped state, validate config, then start
Use descriptive VM IDs that reflect purpose (e.g., 101-k3s-master-01)
common_patterns: Create from template, customize, then start
Provision multiple VMs in parallel for cluster setup

parameter_guidelines.vmid: Choose unused ID in range (100-999 for VMs)
parameter_guidelines.cores: Match workload: 2-4 for general, 8+ for intensive
parameter_guidelines.memory: 4096 MB minimum for modern Linux, 8192+ for K8s nodes
parameter_guidelines.storage: Use appropriate storage pool (local-lvm for VMs, local for ISOs)

use_cases: Starting VMs after creation or shutdown
Automated startup sequences for dependent VMs
best_practices: Verify VM exists and is in stopped state before starting
Wait for VM to fully boot before proceeding (use get_vm_status)
Start dependencies first (e.g., database before app server)
Monitor startup logs for errors
Implement startup timeout to detect boot failures
common_patterns: Start cluster nodes in specific order (master before workers)
Batch start with health check verification

use_cases: Monitoring VM health and resource usage
best_practices: Poll status before and after operations
Monitor CPU and memory usage for scaling decisions
Check disk usage to prevent out-of-space issues
Use status to determine if VM is ready for operations
Track uptime for SLA reporting
common_patterns: Health check loop for cluster monitoring

use_cases: Creating restore points for disaster recovery
best_practices: Always snapshot before major changes
Use descriptive snapshot names with timestamp
Don't keep too many snapshots (performance impact)
Test snapshot restoration periodically
Document what each snapshot represents
common_patterns: Daily snapshot schedule for critical VMs

use_cases: Setting up workspace for infrastructure deployment
best_practices: Always run init before plan or apply
Use -upgrade flag to update providers when needed
Verify backend configuration before init
Check for .terraform.lock.hcl changes after init
Commit lock file to version control
Always run plan before apply
Review plan output carefully for unexpected changes
Save plan to file for consistent apply
Use -out flag to avoid drift between plan and apply
Check for resource destruction warnings
common_patterns: plan with specific target for isolated changes

best_practices: NEVER use auto_approve in production without confirmation_token
Always run plan first to preview changes
Use workspace protection for critical environments
Take state backup before major applies
Monitor apply progress and be ready to interrupt
Verify resources after apply completes
common_patterns: apply in non-production, plan in production
apply with -target for specific resource updates
safety_considerations: Workspace protection blocks applies on production/prod/main
Confirmation token must match workspace name
All applies are logged to audit trail

use_cases: Managing multiple deployments of same config
best_practices: Always verify current workspace before operations
Use workspace naming convention (env-purpose)
Don't perform destructive ops without workspace verification
Document workspace purpose and owner
Protect production workspaces from accidental changes
Always use check mode first for dry-run validation
Specify inventory file explicitly
Use tags for partial playbook execution
Set appropriate timeout for long-running tasks
Use vault for sensitive variables
Limit execution to specific hosts when testing
common_patterns: Playbook with dynamic inventory from Proxmox

best_practices: Use for simple tasks only (complex logic belongs in playbooks)
Specify module explicitly for clarity
Use check mode where applicable
Limit to specific host pattern for safety
Log adhoc commands for audit trail
common_patterns: service module for service status checks

best_practices: Verify inventory before playbook execution
Use dynamic inventory for cloud resources
Keep inventory organized by environment and role
Document host variables and groups
Validate inventory file syntax

learned_optimizations.title: Parallel VM provisioning for cluster setup
learned_optimizations.description: Create multiple VMs in parallel instead of sequentially
learned_optimizations.before: Create VMs one by one, 5 minutes each, total 15 minutes for 3 VMs
learned_optimizations.after: Create all VMs in parallel, total 5 minutes

learned_optimizations.title: Always snapshot before configuration changes
learned_optimizations.description: Create Proxmox snapshots before running Ansible playbooks
learned_optimizations.before: No snapshot, manual recovery from backup if issues
learned_optimizations.after: Automatic snapshot, instant rollback on failure
learned_optimizations.impact: Recovery time reduced from hours to minutes

learned_optimizations.title: Use OpenTofu workspaces for environment isolation
learned_optimizations.description: Separate dev/staging/prod into workspaces instead of separate configs
learned_optimizations.before: Duplicate Terraform configs, hard to maintain consistency
learned_optimizations.impact: 90% reduction in config duplication, easier updates

learned_optimizations.title: Enforce workspace protection for production
learned_optimizations.description: Block destructive operations on protected workspaces
learned_optimizations.impact: Zero production incidents from accidental applies

prerequisites: Valid API token with VM management permissions
Network connectivity to Proxmox API (default port 8006)
SSH access to Proxmox nodes (for advanced operations)
Provider credentials configured (AWS, Azure, GCP, etc.)
safety_requirements: State file never committed to git

prerequisites: Inventory file or dynamic inventory configured
best_practices: Use Ansible Vault for secrets
Test with check mode first
Use roles for reusability
Tag tasks for selective execution

common_pitfalls.pitfall: Not waiting for VM to fully boot before configuration
common_pitfalls.prevention: Poll get_vm_status and test SSH connectivity before run_playbook

common_pitfalls.pitfall: Forgetting to select correct OpenTofu workspace
common_pitfalls.impact: Deploying to wrong environment, potential production impact
common_pitfalls.prevention: Always workspace_select explicitly, verify before plan/apply

common_pitfalls.pitfall: Not testing Ansible playbooks in check mode
common_pitfalls.prevention: Always run playbook with check mode first, review changes

common_pitfalls.pitfall: Creating VMs without proper resource allocation
common_pitfalls.prevention: Use resource calculation based on workload, monitor Proxmox node capacity

common_pitfalls.pitfall: Not creating snapshots before risky operations
common_pitfalls.prevention: Always create_vm_snapshot before major updates or configuration changes
